title: Hardwiring circuit inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n+m$ input vertices, and let $y$ be a Boolean assignment to the last $m$ inputs. Form a circuit with $n$ input vertices by placing, before the gates of $C$, one constant gate for each value of $y$, in order; retain the gates of $C$ and its output vertex.
